name: boudig
text: boudig names a Breton word that translates as fairy in English. The fuller Breton fairy record sits with korrigan, the other Breton term for this kind of being.

attributes.attribute: one of two Breton words for a fairy; the other Breton word is korrigan

okr.objective: Identify boudig as one of two Breton words for fairy and link to korrigan.
key_results: Names boudig as one of two Breton words for fairy.
Cross-references korrigan for the full Breton fairy record.
